scenarios.name: Move the main window using the application bar

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the main window is restored within the desktop work area
the user drags an empty region of the application bar within the work area
the entire window follows the drag without changing size
the same part remains active in the viewport
